title: IESCO Power Suspension Scheduled for November 8
excerpt: Parts of Islamabad, Rawalpindi, and Jhelum will face up to 10 hours of electricity suspension on Sunday, November 8.
body_html:
The Islamabad Electric Supply Company (IESCO) has announced plans to suspend power in specific areas across three cities. Residents and businesses in parts of Islamabad, Rawalpindi, and Jhelum will experience electricity outages lasting up to 10 hours.

The scheduled power suspension is set to take place on Sunday, November 8. Authorities have outlined the temporary interruption to facilitate necessary work, affecting various localities within the mentioned regions.
